White or green body colour with blue or green corrugated roofing is the dominant visual pattern. Studio white-background shots (187429497) and outdoor yard/roadside shots (250933505, 292706211, 236920834) are both acceptable; the key requirement is that the full unit — cabins, chassis, tank, and access ladder — is visible in a single frame.
